Headline: #36 Broadway Temporary Reroute at Broadway/Belmont
ShortDescription: #36 Broadway buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Broadway/Belmont.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#36 Broadway buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Broadway, Belmont, Halsted, Clark and over the regular route, due to street blockage near Broadway/Belmont.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Northbound #29 State and Eastbound #75 74th/75th Temporary Reroute near State/79th
ShortDescription: #29 State and #75 74th/75th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near State/79th.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#29 State and #75 74th/75th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near State/79th.

Northbound #29 State buses will operate via State, 79th, I-94, Exit at 76th, and State, then over the regular route.

Eastbound #75 74th/75th buses will operate via 79th, State, I-94, Exit at 76th, and State then over the regular route.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Green Line trains  Delays
ShortDescription: Green Line trains are running with residual delays an following an earlier signal problem at 63rd Cottage Grove. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Green Line trains are running with residual delays and congestion following  earlier signal problems at 63rd Cottage Grove. 


Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.


Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
